title: Sponsorship Checklist
subtitle: Capture benefit package, logo asset, placement, and announcement; confirm in-kind value and fulfillment.
description: Sponsorship records benefit package, logo asset, placement, announcement, in-kind value, and fulfillment. Sponsorship evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this sponsorship stage-gated verification when staff must document benefit package and logo asset. Reconcile placement, announcement, in-kind value, and fulfillment before the sponsorship handoff. Use the signed commitment reference, benefit inventory, brand-asset approval, placement proof, announcement schedule, hospitality redemption, valuation record, and make-good acceptance. Ask the assigned sponsorship reviewer to confirm benefit package against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Sponsorship starting details
sections.guidance: Detail benefit package, logo file and brand approval, placement dimensions, announcement copy, hospitality inventory, in-kind valuation, and fulfillment proof.

sections.title: Sponsorship checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current sponsorship facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Sponsorship required checks
items: Benefit package is identified for this record
Logo asset matches the current request or source
Placement is ready for point-of-use staff
Announcement limits or questions are resolved
In-kind value is communicated to the responsible person
A changed sponsorship fact is returned for review

sections.title: Sponsorship decision and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold sponsorship readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Sponsorship reviewer receipt

fields.label: Event coordinator or responsible staff and date

blocks.guidance: Sponsorship receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
